5.30.betting_forecast: 7/2 No Knee Never, 9/2 Alazwar, Volendam, 5/1 Rainwater, 7/1 Book Of Life, 8/1 Pessoa, 14/1 King Of The Dance, 16/1
5.30.spotlight_verdict: An open-looking contest but the handicapper has dropped RAINWATER a further 2lb following a Southwell defeat where he met trouble in running. He is selected ahead of No Knee Never who rarely runs a bad race and is 2-2 for Henry Callan. Another to consider is Alazwar who confirmed his wellbeing when runner-up at Lingfield last Monday. Course specialist Pessoa can never be left out of calculations around here. [Andrew Bladen]

horses.spotlight_comment: Has gone close when placed twice this year, latest when second of 11 at Lingfield (1m, AW) last Monday; on a decent mark and is one to consider.
Has an inconsistent profile, having scored over C&D last month off a 2lb lower mark but has only beaten two home in three runs since; hard to assess.
Doesn't win very often (2-38) but he's made the frame on his three starts this month and should not be far away.
Has run with credit since winning at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) last July but is a victim of his own consistency and probably needs to drop a couple of pounds before finding another opening.
All four wins when trained by Dean Ivory; finished last of 12 at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) on her sole start for Clare Hobson last month; headgear removed for stable debut; hard to make a case for.

Rarely runs a bad race and won for the third time this year under Henry Callan at Lingfield (1m, AW) last Monday; possibly found the run coming too soon when below best back on turf at Beverley three days later; should not be far away if another quick run doesn't count against him.
horses.breeding: b g No Nay Never - Question Times

horses.spotlight_comment: All seven wins have been here, including three over C&D; in the money twice here since his last win and holds place claims at least.

Both wins for Noel Meade in Ireland; runner-up in a big-field amateur jockeys' handicap at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) last month; slow to start last time at Lingfield and has an inconsistent profile.
horses.breeding: b g James Garfield - Rebel Aclaim

horses.spotlight_comment: 2-34 but only faded late after racing prominently at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) and met trouble in running when fifth of 12 at Southwell (7f, AW; 100-30) 12 days ago; on career-low mark and may be ready to take advantage.
Breakthrough win at Newcastle (1m, AW) last September was her 23rd career start; not so hot since, so it's probably best to look elsewhere for win purposes.
horses.breeding: b m Oasis Dream - Sassy Gal

horses.spotlight_comment: Four wins for William Muir and Chris Grassick; winless for current yard last year and has dropped to a career-low mark on first run for 209 days; may be best watched this time.
horses.breeding: b g Oasis Dream - La Pyle

horses.spotlight_comment: Placed on four of her last five AW starts before getting off the mark at the 18th attempt back on turf at Bath (1m, good) 22 days ago; back up 7lb but she should remain competitive without looking an obvious one to follow up.
All six wins have been on AW but has yet to win beyond 1m and not in the best of form at present; has dropped to a career-low mark but doesn't look ready to take advantage.
Has an inconsistent profile, having scored over C&D last month off a 2lb lower mark but has only beaten two home in three runs since; hard to assess.
All four wins when trained by Dean Ivory; finished last of 12 at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) on her sole start for Clare Hobson last month; headgear removed for stable debut; hard to make a case for.
All seven wins have been here, including three over C&D; in the money twice here since his last win and holds place claims at least.

Both wins for Noel Meade in Ireland; runner-up in a big-field amateur jockeys' handicap at Doncaster (1m, good to soft) last month; slow to start last time at Lingfield and has an inconsistent profile.
horses.breeding: b g James Garfield - Rebel Aclaim

horses.spotlight_comment: Placed on four of her last five AW starts before getting off the mark at the 18th attempt back on turf at Bath (1m, good) 22 days ago; back up 7lb but she should remain competitive without looking an obvious one to follow up.
All six wins have been on AW but has yet to win beyond 1m and not in the best of form at present; has dropped to a career-low mark but doesn't look ready to take advantage.

6.00.betting_forecast: 11/8 Littlecote, 2/1 Shayhana, 3/1 Electric Arc, 14/1 Semele, 16/1 Exquisite Skye, 20/1 Noble Grace, 50/1 Six Blue, 66/1
6.00.spotlight_verdict: Only of a few of these can be considered and this looks to be a good opportunity for LITTLECOTE to land her first race. She may have most to fear from debutante Electric Arc. Another who should run well is Shayhana who could show improvement after finishing runner-up on her first start last November. [Andrew Bladen]

horses.spotlight_comment: Third foal; by Postponed; half-sister to 7f 2yo/1m4f Listed winner Novakai (RPR 109); dam 1m4f-1m6f winner (including AW; 98), half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Elas Ruby, out of Listed-placed 1m 2yo winning half-sister to 2m2f Group 2 winner Pallasator; has a good middle-distance pedigree and yard respected; needs a look in the betting.
Placed three times for Alice Haynes last year; steps up in trip on stable debut and more required.
horses.breeding: b f A'Ali - Terre Du Vent

horses.spotlight_comment: Runner-up in a couple of similar events at Southwell and Kempton (1m4f and 1m3f) this year and this looks to be a good opportunity to get off the mark.
Beaten a neck in a bumper on her racecourse debut but a disappointing maiden over hurdles; tall order on her belated Flat debut.
0-3 in three bumpers; fourth of eight on Flat debut at Kempton (1m3f, AW) four weeks ago; needs to show improvement.
Second of three on her debut at Lingfield (1m4f, AW) last November; can be expected to show improvement for her good yard; holds claims.
Tailed off at big odds on all three bumper starts; performed better when sixth of eight on her Flat debut at Kempton (1m3f, AW) last month but should not be good enough for this race.
Has shown little in her two starts and needs more time.

6.30.betting_forecast: 7/2 Epictetus, 4/1 Lordsbridge Blu, 5/1 Jez Bomb, 11/2 Big Sip, 7/1 Renesmee, 8/1 Echalar, 10/1 Newfangled, 12/1 City Of God,
6.30.spotlight_verdict: Lordsbridge Blu (second choice) must come into the reckoning after finishing second here last month but ECHALAR (nap) ran his best race for these connections last time and looks interesting now up in trip. Epictetus continues to run well, while Big Sip can build on his reappearance effort. [Andrew Bladen]

horses.spotlight_comment: Landed a seller over C&D last October; only beaten 2l when sixth of 11 at Lingfield (1m, AW) 13 days ago on his first run back and should be suited by the step up in trip; can go well.

Landed seller on final start for Karl Burke at Chelmsford (1m, AW) in February in first-time cheekpieces; headgear absent when fifth of nine at Kempton (1m, AW) three weeks ago on stable debut; cheekpieces back on; stepping up in trip but may need to come down in the weights.

Won here (7f) off 1lb higher in January when trained by Jane Chapple-Hyam; posted easily his most encouraging display since joining current yard when a keeping-on sixth of 13 at Southwell (1m, AW) 20 days ago; steps up in trip on a career-low mark and must come into consideration.
horses.breeding: b g Too Darn Hot - Rocana

horses.spotlight_comment: Has gone close recently and was only beaten half a length at Lingfield (1m, AW) 13 days ago but is without a win since landing a Group 3 for the Gosdens three years ago; looks sure to be thereabouts once again.
Four wins last year and has run with credit on his three starts this term, albeit he is 6lb higher than his last winning mark; should run well but needs a career-best to get his head in front.
horses.breeding: b g Hunter's Light - Cherina Dynamite

horses.spotlight_comment: Won twice, including over C&D; most encouraging when runner-up over C&D four weeks ago on his return from a break and should go close here.

Has two course wins, including one over C&D; fair fifth of 11 at Lingfield (1m, AW) 13 days ago an first outing for six months; should come on for the run but looks high enough in the weights for now.
Won twice for Jane Chapple-Hyam in 2024; 0-4 for current yard and has had wind surgery since has last run in October; best watched for now.
horses.breeding: ch g New Bay - Fact Or Folklore

horses.spotlight_comment: In good heart at present, winning at Chelmsford (1m, AW) last month off 6lb lower and in the money twice since; steps back up in trip and she should run well again.

7.00.betting_forecast: 11/4 Vidmiyr, 7/2 Clementines Star, 4/1 Cotai Eye Joe, Imelda, 11/2 Santiago Boy, 14/1 Thai Princess, 16/1 King Cherry, 25/1
7.00.spotlight_verdict: Imelda made a promising debut over C&D this month and is respected but VIDMIYR has a good chance on the figures if judged on his Irish 2yo form and is taken to make a winning stable debut. Clementines Star is next on the list.[Chris Wilson]

horses.spotlight_comment: Perhaps a shade disappointing on her second 2yo start but her keeping-on third of 12 at Newcastle (6f) was a promising debut; has a big role to play if back at that level on this reappearance outing.
Fair form when third on both starts, latterly in tactical Newcastle race (7f) last month; probably needs to improve here but that's possible.
Well beaten on first two appearances, more recently when 200-1 for C&D maiden this month; hood added today.

Fourth foal; half-brother to 6f winner Babe Alicious (including AW; RPR 61); dam placed 1m 2yo (including AW; 68), half-sister to 1m5f Listed winner Charleston Lady and a Japanese 1m Group 3 winner; stable has only occasional debut winners.
First foal from a prolific 1m-1m2f winner; well beaten on debut at Goodwood (6f, good) in October but was only 15-2 that day and the early stages did not go well; ought to be capable of much better.
Out of a close relative of 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Nations Alexander; ran well from the front when second over C&D on debut three weeks ago; obvious contender if able to build on that performance.
Friendless in the betting but certainly not disgraced when midfield on debut at Kempton (6f) three weeks ago; now needs to build on that effort.
Down the field on first two starts, both at Southwell this month (7f/1m); needs to take a big step forward.
Struggled on both 2yo starts (7.3f/7f) and can only be watched on this reappearance outing.

24,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Military Mission (9.5f-1m4f including Australian Group 2; RPR 116) and Augeval (Italian 1m); dam German 7f-1m winner; already gelded but makes debut in a run-of-the-mill maiden; market helpful.
In a top stable but began career with two low-key runs, the latter a sixth of eight over C&D this month (race in which Imelda was second).

Made the frame on the last two of his three 2yo starts for Johnny Murtagh in Ireland, more recently when coming from the rear for fourth at Dundalk (7f) in October; bought for 48,000euros in November; has good chance here if fully tuned up for stable debut.

7.30.betting_forecast: 3/1 Shes Got The Blues, 7/2 Giles Glory, 5/1 Electrocution, 6/1 Frankali, Sirhana, 10/1 Based, Monk's Hill, 14/1 Starakova, 20/1
7.30.spotlight_verdict: Giles Glory is on a workable mark for this stable debut and can be dangerous if boosted by a change of headgear but perhaps it might be worth chancing SIRHANA, who took a step in the right direction when fifth at Southwell last month. Electrocution and Frankali also make the shortlist. Shes Got The Blues went very close over 1m recently but it's hard to tell whether this drop back in trip will suit.[Chris Wilson]

horses.spotlight_comment: Well down the field on all three 2yo starts, albeit not beaten that far at Kempton (7f) on latest outing in November (gelded soon afterwards); improvement required on this seasonal/handicap debut.
horses.breeding: b g Oasis Dream - La Dorotea

horses.spotlight_comment: Unexposed after only four starts but absent since finishing well down the field on nursery debut at Bath (5.7f, good to firm) in September; gelded in November; upped in trip for this seasonal/AW debut.
Belied 80-1 odds when keeping-on fourth over C&D on last month's handicap debut but was well beaten when upped to 1m at Lingfield a fortnight ago; others have more convincing profiles.
Placed twice off today's mark since opening account over C&D in February; needs to rebound from a below-par effort this month but still features prominently in calculations.

Lost her chance at the start on latest outing and is now 0-7 but has twice finished third on Polytrack this year and is quite well handicapped on those efforts; could have a say, despite awkward draw.

Emphatic winner in first-time visor for Joseph Parr at Lingfield (7f) in January and signed off for him with two pretty good fourths on Polytrack in February/March; subsequently changed hands for 2,800gns; big player if he responds well to first-time blinkers on stable debut.
horses.breeding: b g Cotai Glory - Imperial Butterfly

horses.spotlight_comment: Soundly beaten a huge odds in three turf novices races (6f-7.3f) last summer; makes handicap/AW debut after 263-day absence; hood fitted.
Bumped into an improver when second at Newcastle (7f) last month and is of interest if judged on that performance but was well beaten on turf a fortnight ago and is now 0-7.
horses.breeding: b f Dandy Man - All Star Cast

horses.spotlight_comment: Not disgraced when seventh here (8.6f) last month but yet to be placed after nine starts; soundly beaten the only previous time she wore cheekpieces (last season); difficult to enthuse over.

11-race maiden; lost out only by a short head off basement mark at Southwell (1m, AW) this month but went up 3lb for that, has wide draw here and needs to prove she can cope with the drop back in trip.
Yet to be placed after six starts but her fifth of 12 at Southwell (7f) last month was quite encouraging; 2lb lower here and capable 5lb claimer Ethan Tindall is enlisted; worth a second look.
Unplaced all seven starts; began season with quite promising fifth of 11 at Chelmsford (7f) in March but her turf run a fortnight ago was disappointing and she now has a point to prove.
Well down the field on all three 2yo starts, albeit not beaten that far at Kempton (7f) on latest outing in November (gelded soon afterwards); improvement required on this seasonal/handicap debut.
horses.breeding: b g Oasis Dream - La Dorotea

8.00.betting_forecast: 11/4 Favourite Friend, 7/2 Crown Inn To Win, Forever Perfect, 8/1 Bradbury, Montu, 14/1 Maryland Star, Song Of The Stars, 16/1
8.00.spotlight_verdict: Forever Perfect and Crown Inn To Win came home 1-2 over C&D recently and seem sure to be on the premises again, while the in-form maiden Montu (second choice) is also firmly in the picture. Sir Mark Prescott's FAVOURITE FRIEND appeals as a likely improver now he goes into handicaps with his stamina unlocked and he gets the vote.[Peter Entwistle]

horses.spotlight_comment: Has offered little in her three runs to date, beating just one in 7f novice here in January; handicap debutante.

Sent off 9-4 for his handicap debut at Lingfield (1m2f) last month but he went keenly before fading into fifth; tongue strap goes on now with more needed if he's to get off the mark over this longer trip.
horses.breeding: b g Ghaiyyath - Glimmer Of Peace

horses.spotlight_comment: Progressive form since sent into handicaps this year, set a lot to do when a clear second of six to Forever Perfect over C&D six days ago; hood retained and tongue tied is also added; player off an unchanged mark.

Sea The Moon gelding; always behind on his four starts to date, coming in a well-held sixth of eight in 9.5f maiden here on his return 18 days ago; much more is expected now he goes handicapping stepped up in trip; interesting.
horses.breeding: br g Sea The Moon - Fanny

horses.spotlight_comment: Much improved recently for the step up to 1m4f and she got off the mark over C&D six days ago, edging out Crown Inn To Win late on; not taken lightly under a 6lb penalty.
Cut little ice in a trio of novices (around 1m) last autumn; needs this switch to handicaps/longer trip to spark major improvement.
horses.breeding: b f Time Test - Great And Small

horses.spotlight_comment: Yet to offer much in five outings, a never-dangerous sixth in 9.5f handicap here 17 days ago; cheekpieces go on now.
Returned from six months off with her best effort when third of eight in 9.5f maiden here 18 days ago; may do better still now venturing into handicaps.
horses.breeding: b f Cable Bay - All Things Gold

horses.spotlight_comment: Failed to kick on for Charlie Johnston and he was gelded before coming in last of five in 1m4f Kempton handicap in January; starts out for a new yard with something to prove; first-time tongue tie.
Arrives in good nick, cheekpieces added when third of 11 in 1m4f Kempton handicap four weeks ago; he can go well again off the same mark in his bid for a breakthrough victory.
Ghaiyyath filly who advanced her form on her handicap debut when fourth of seven over C&D last month; she needs to take another step forward now though.

8.30.betting_forecast: 3/1 Forever Noah, 7/2 Candy Warhol, 5/1 Dark Side Prince, 7/1 Macarone, Master Dandy, 9/1 Henery Hawk, 12/1 Basholo, Isla
8.30.spotlight_verdict: There shouldn't be a shortage of early pace and this could tee up nicely for something more patiently ridden. Isla Bella is a possible but the drop back into 0-60 company could be the catalyst for a return to form from multiple C&D winner BASHOLO. Master Dandy may prove best of the rest.[Paul Smith]

horses.spotlight_comment: Barclay Zak Wheatley (3) 12-1 60 65 69 Won twice over C&D in late 2025, the latter success coming off a 2lb higher mark; more recent efforts need bettering but this is likely to be run to suit and dropping back into a 0-60 could see her bounce back to form.

On his last winning mark and there have been several good runs since he had a wind operation last October, including last week's Lingfield second (5f AW); drawn widest here though and that may prove his undoing.
Prolific 5f winner, including over C&D, most recently at Chelmsford in October off 2lb lower; however, he was disappointing back at Chelmsford in February and has a bit to prove this time.
horses.breeding: b g Equiano - Dark Side Princess

horses.spotlight_comment: Successful in a 6f handicap at Chelmsford in February off a 4lb lower mark; runner-up here (6f) on his last two starts and he has run well over 5f in the past; should give his running.
horses.breeding: b g Dark Angel - Poppet's Passion

horses.spotlight_comment: C&D winner; two good runs here last month but he was never in the hunt back here 18 days ago; has the ability to feature but he will need luck in running from stall 1 given his racing style.

Losing run stands at 18 but she has run some good races in defeat for Joey Ramsden, including over C&D; down the field at Doncaster on Friday but she's capable of bouncing back quickly; stable also runs Forever Noah.
horses.breeding: b f Land Force - High Luminosity

horses.spotlight_comment: Non-runner.

Won two 6f handicaps here last autumn and he is now 4lb lower than for the latter win; more recent efforts leave him with a point to prove but the fitting of a tongue-tie could give him a lift and Silvestre De Sousa is a positive booking.
horses.breeding: b g Havana Grey - Multi Quest

horses.spotlight_comment: Ran poorly at Newcastle last month but he had been in good form beforehand, winning over C&D and at Chelmsford in January; holds Forever Noah on the Chelmsford run and could bounce back after a short break.
Won twice on AW this winter, including C&D, and he is now 2lb lower than for the second win; has gone quiet more recently though and could prove vulnerable for win purposes once again.
